title: Sunflower Punk Duality
description: Two side-by-side illustrations of a female character with spiky black hair, sunflower accessories, and a yellow-and-black punk outfit against a solid green background. The left pose shows her with both hands raised in a rock-on gesture, while the right pose shows her holding a sunflower near her chest.
prompt: A female character with wild spiky black hair, yellow headband with sunflowers, wearing a yellow cropped jacket with sunflower patterns, black corset belt, yellow skirt, black thigh-high stockings with circular patterns, and yellow combat boots. She has a long black braided tail ending in a sunflower. Shown in two poses side by side on a solid bright green background: left pose with both hands raised making rock-on gestures, right pose holding a sunflower with both hands near her face, anime-influenced digital illustration style with bold black outlines and vibrant colors
